construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict object containing schema_version=1, synthetic=true, feedback, themes, knowledge, steps, completed_steps, research_sources. Collections are arrays; ids are nonempty and unique within their collection.
shared_schema.source: {id, title, text}; used for knowledge and research_sources
shared_schema.citation: {source_id, start, end, excerpt}; zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode code-point offsets, resolved against the applicable input source collection
shared_schema.validation: One shared ValidationError/require layer checks strict input fields, collection ids, prerequisite DAG, evidence offsets, extractive answer identity, lineage and stage-specific output contracts. Each downstream stage validates its predecessor before consuming it.
shared_schema.errors: CLI file, JSON and validation failures produce one JSON object with status=error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: feedback -> faq: detected theme definitions, deduplicated supporting excerpts and original feedback ids drive FAQ queries
faq -> guided: answered versus abstained FAQ status gates onboarding; citations and feedback ids propagate
guided -> normal: only ready/completed steps supply research queries including FAQ extracts; step ids, feedback ids and FAQ citations propagate

behavior.feedback: Casefolded word-sequence deduplication ignores punctuation and whitespace; retains every original id and a full canonical excerpt. Configured keyword token sets determine possibly overlapping themes; unmatched feedback is explicit.
behavior.faq: Require a configured theme keyword token set in each eligible passage, then retrieve one sentence by maximum non-stopword query-token overlap. Ties sort by source id then offset. Exact sentence answer or explicit abstained/null/empty citations.
behavior.guided: Select detected-topic steps plus transitive prerequisites. Validate supplied completion claims against prerequisites and grounded FAQs. Report completed, ready, blocked, needs_answer and completed/total progress. Rerun with updated completed_steps to track progress.
behavior.normal: Extract a single matching research passage for each actionable onboarding step, with exact source offsets. No matching passage means explicit abstention.
behavior.determinism: No random choices, timestamps, network access or model calls in the implementation.
behavior.fixtures: All example customer records, knowledge and research documents are synthetic.

excluded: Automatic factual verification beyond exact source grounding
scope.limitations: Lexical overlap is not semantic understanding: irrelevant passages sharing query words can match. Sentence splitting is intentionally simple and may split abbreviations. No LLM callable is needed or included.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object, status=ok, four ordered validated stages
coverage: CLI success, file errors, usage errors and malformed JSON
